messages:
cheng: Kickoff for ACME private VPC delivery — edge cluster bring-up in eu-west-2. Customer wants air-gapped images, VPC peering to our transit VPC, and strict egress controls. Posting a concise validation/handoff checklist so SRE + Delivery can run it during the window.

alex: Ack. Can we confirm GPU SKUs and counts? ACME ordered 8xH100 nodes + 4xA100 for fallback. Need firmware/driver matrix validated before boot.

maria: Networking notes: customer terminator will do IPsec to our transit VM. They block 0.0.0.0/0 egress from compute — only allowed to talk to registry/bastion. Need static routes + DNS stub. Also confirm MTU (they use 9000).

ops_lead: Checklist I ran locally, paste for copy/paste during handoff: 
1) Inventory: ensure node labels + GPU allocatable match order. `kubectl get nodes -L gpu-type` and `kubectl describe node <node>`
2) Drivers: check nvidia-smi and driver versions. `nvidia-smi --query-gpu=driver_version --format=csv`
3) Offline images: sync to customer registry (bastion) and import to air-gapped registry. Example sync commands below.

ops_lead: ```bash
# on build host (internet-facing)
skopeo sync --src docker --dest dir docker://registry.redwood.ai/model-server:prod /tmp/images
for f in /tmp/images/*.tar; do scp -i ~/.ssh/acme_deploy $f acme@bastion:/tmp/images/; done
# on bastion (customer side)
ssh acme@bastion 'ctr -n=k8s.io images import /tmp/images/*.tar'
```

alex: GPU validation quick checks: `kubectl run gpu-test --rm --image=nvcr.io/nvidia/k8s/cuda-sample:vectoradd --limits=nvidia.com/gpu=1 -- sleep 60` then `kubectl logs -f pod/gpu-test` to verify kernels load. Also check MIG partitioning if they requested it.

maria: Networking validation checklist: 
- Confirm IPsec SA established: `sudo ipsec statusall` on terminator.
- Confirm routes from transit VPC -> customer internal prefixes via BGP/static routes.
- DNS: push stub resolver to nodes or configure CoreDNS to forward to customer's DNS over TCP.
- MTU test: `ping -M do -s 8972 <peer>` to validate jumbo frames.

customer-eng: FYI, ACME insisted on a maintenance window Fri 02:00-06:00 UTC. Acceptance criteria: p50 latency <200ms for 512-token generation at 8 concurrent requests, and successful image import + node GPU health.

cheng: Add cost callout — they want a breakdown of committed vs burst GPU hours. Ops, attach the cost projection used in the quote for the cluster.

ops_lead: Cost snippet we should hand off: `committed: 8xH100-monthly; burst: +4xA100 spot; baseline network egress limited by policy`. I attached the excel in the ticket.

maria: Security: Ensure KMS keys are provisioned on customer side for the private control plane certs. Upload CA bundle via scp to bastion and run `redwoodctl register-ca --file /tmp/ca.pem`.

ops_lead: Handoff run sequence (short): 
1) Pre-window: confirm hardware + drivers, push images to bastion.
2) Window start: bring up control plane nodes, import images to registry, run smoke k8s pods.
3) Mid-window: run GPU smoke and perf test (see commands).
4) End-window: snapshot logs, export `kubectl get --all-namespaces pods -o wide` and perf results, hand back to customer-eng for acceptance.

cheng: Perf test command for QA: `python perf_test.py --endpoint http://10.10.5.2:8080/generate --concurrency 8 --tokens 512 --duration 120` — capture p50/p95 and token/sec.

oncall-bot: Ticket TKT-4321: ACME-edge-deploy moved to In Progress by cheng. ETA window Fri 02:00-06:00 UTC. Please escalate in-channel if any node fails GPU health checks.

alex: Quick gotcha: customer NAT on their egress path drops STS refresh calls if sessions exceed 30s. For the private control plane confirm token refresh endpoints are routed via the bastion and not blocked.

maria: Also verifying cluster-autoscaler won't attempt to reach public instance metadata. Patch nodes with `--provider-id` stub or set `--skip-unneeded-checks` per our airgap guidance.

customer-eng: We'll run acceptance tests after the handoff. If perf looks good we'll sign-off and request Dedicated billing enablement. :thumbsup:

cheng: Thanks all — I'll run the pre-window checklist tomorrow and post final signoff in this thread before the window. If anyone has items to add, drop them now.
